issues.title: feat(check): emit native diff output set from one analysis (#8169)
issues.body:
## Summary

A consumer that needs badge JSON, detail JSON and human output currently launches native diff analysis three times. `ripr check --root ROOT --diff NAMED_FILE --output-dir NEW_DIRECTORY` now runs the existing diff pipeline once, retains effective configuration and the union of presentation inputs, and emits `badge.json`, `detail.json`, `human.txt` plus a final `manifest.json`.

Existing single-format parsing and native projections remain the comparison authority. The new protocol does not replay explain artifacts or change classifier/cache behavior.

## Swarm / Source Boundary

- [x] ordinary feature development for `ripr-swarm`

## Source-of-truth Links

Governing issue: #8169. Spec: RIPR-SPEC-0001. Acceptance delta: one explicit bounded output set shares one native diff analysis while retaining native bytes and refusing detectable drift or incomplete publication. Proposal/ADR: n/a; no new analyzer capability claim.

## Candidate Relationships

Candidate: `codex/8169-native-diff-fanout` at `6a47f5bf094e5b010845b544f9464333a8b90d7d`, tree `2a15b485aa9684ff9ea05159e429641433dd550b`, frozen integration basis `b772d9e13cafcdc84a19ea77d9b90fbc6cb91ecc`.

No stack/replacement. Repeated all-state claim search found no competing #8169/native output-set candidate (the #2040 issue-number hit is an upstream Tokio reference). #8004 owns classifier/cache work: no production path in that lane changed; only `.ripr/traceability.toml` is shared, in separate spec sections. Existing UB qualification ownership and #1358 remain authoritative. No UB consumer or analyzer pin changes.

## Scope / Scope Classification

- [x] One public contract

Production: CLI dispatch and native presentation reuse; optional root-scoped input-read guard; bounded observed-input custody; exclusive member writes and final manifest admission. Evidence: discriminating units/CLI cases, schema/help/spec/changelog and traceability. Non-goals: classifier/cache optimization, explain-to-gate promotion, UB adoption, pin qualification, release work.

## Support-tier Impact

- [x] changes a CLI/JSON/docs claim

The new opt-in output-set protocol is documented. Language support tiers and native analysis semantics do not advance.

## Policy Impact

No policy exception, dependency change, process producer, network surface, workflow or gate change. Configured Perl producers are refused for this mode; explicit native facts remain supported.

## Proof

At final head `6a47f5bf094e5b010845b544f9464333a8b90d7d`:

```bash
cargo xtask check-fast
cargo test --locked -p ripr --lib fanout_
cargo test --locked -p ripr --test cli_smoke native_fanout
cargo xtask precommit
cargo check --locked -p ripr --lib --no-default-features --features lang-rust
```

All exited 0. `check-fast` ran 14 gates including workspace/all-target Clippy with `-D warnings`; its selector independently agrees with the successful Git diff's 15 paths and merge base. It skipped its separate fixture-contract gate; precommit subsequently passed fixture contracts and the remaining listed checks. Unit filter: 14 passed (12 new controls plus 2 incidental existing name matches); CLI: 9 passed. Rust-only compilation passed with 26 unused/dead-code warnings in existing declarations. Existing repeated-single-format parsing (1 test) and findings-budget (2 tests) controls also passed on `9ace0ec5...`; the final seven-line lint-only delta leaves those dimensions unchanged. Precommit's capability report includes retained historical reference disagreements, not a fresh efficacy run.

The unit counter instruments the actual diff-pipeline entry across threads and asserts fan-out enters once. The comparison harness launches three separate standalone native invocations. CLI controls compare exact member bytes against separate native invocations, with nondefault effective configuration/mode, custom dated suppressions, Rust/Python/TypeScript, Python notes and navigation, nonempty source stamps, limited JSON, malformed diff/config, native refusal documents and unsupported exits. Separate machine/human navigation contexts preserve Python-only presentation behavior.

Custody controls mutate diff/config/source/suppressions/facts/directory membership/date, auxiliary binding and destination identity; worker reads outside the captured root/inside excluded metadata are refused. Render limits, member/manifest write failures and late drift leave no final completion marker. Existing output directories cannot be reused.

The baseline behavioral red rejected `--output-dir` before implementation. Earlier instrument/fixture failures are retained in scratch (an unavailable test dependency, a Rust-only source-stamp assumption, and a dormant external module stimulus); corrected controls then reached the actual native path. No failure is counted as a pass. The first exact-head gate run also failed the repository Clippy policy on wildcard error closures and positive Result-state assertions; the final commit names intentionally ignored arguments and uses `?` in Result-returning controls, then refreshes affected proof.

Five alternating AB/BA pairs per workload/cache condition; 20 exact-byte comparisons, 80 measured native processes and 4 excluded warmups. Rust-only fixture inputs in ready mode; 1/64 modules yield 2/128 native findings and 1/64 analyzed tests. Development binary, Linux `RUSAGE_CHILDREN` user+system CPU and `perf_counter` wall; output/error streams redirected to files. Cold means a fresh analyzer cache per variant/pair; the three separate calls share that pair cache. Warm prewarms each variant with native human output and then reuses its cache. No cache-hit rate is asserted. OS caches and ambient host load are uncontrolled. Python subprocess timeout polling limits resolution of the short wall samples. No concurrent builds ran.

| Modules/cache | Median wall: separate → fan-out (s) | Median CPU: separate → fan-out (s) | Native member bytes (both) | Extra manifest bytes |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1/cold | 0.0958 → 0.0319 | 0.0741 → 0.0316 | 16,105 | +5,655 |
| 1/warm | 0.0957 → 0.0318 | 0.0701 → 0.0316 | 16,105 | +5,655 |
| 64/cold | 9.5214 → 3.1786 | 9.9458 → 3.3982 | 634,355 | +18,636 |
| 64/warm | 9.3241 → 3.1244 | 9.6948 → 3.2603 | 634,355 | +18,636 |

These observed development-fixture results are not a general speedup guarantee. Fan-out adds manifest bytes; it does not reduce native member bytes. Every retained manifest/member hash and captured corpus source hash was subsequently checked.

## Claim Boundary

The three members are native projections from one in-process analysis. Inventory bounds: 16,384 entries including auxiliaries, depth 64, 128 MiB captured bytes; total rendered members plus manifest at most 32 MiB. Configured external producers and unbound native source reads fail closed.

`complete_set: true` admits publication of native analysis projections. It does not mean native analysis was complete or gate-successful: check `command_success`, member hashes/lengths and native downstream-consumable/refusal fields. Unsupported native analysis retains its projections with `complete_set=true`, `command_success=false`, exit 2. Pre-analysis refusals write native machine refusal documents, empty human bytes, and both manifest booleans false. Limited native JSON remains limited. Partial files without the final manifest are never an admitted set. Existing files are never replaced.

This is observed persistent-drift detection, not an immutable filesystem: transient change-and-revert, malicious concurrent filesystem replacement, crash durability and compiler/dependency cache integrity are outside the claim. Native Windows execution, release-profile/real UB performance, full workspace/golden matrices, hosted integration and fresh independent review are not established. No assumed 3x gain.

The frozen base has matching manifest `zip = 8` / lock `zip 8.6.0`, unchanged by this PR; inherited yanked-dependency/supply-chain qualification belongs to canonical #8180. Local locked cached builds do not establish fresh-registry or cargo-deny clearance.

## Rollback

Revert these three commits/the eventual squash; 15 paths change, no dependency or migration state. Existing standalone commands remain available. Failed output sets require a fresh destination; this command never deletes or replaces them.

## Spec-Test-Code Traceability

- Spec: `docs/specs/RIPR-SPEC-0001-static-exposure-loop.md`; `.ripr/traceability.toml`.
- Tests: `cli_smoke/native_fanout.rs`; `check_fanout` units; `input_boundary` units; existing parsing/budget controls.
- Code: `cli/commands/check.rs`, `check_fanout.rs`, `analysis/input_boundary.rs`, existing source/module read owners.
- Golden outputs: no blessings or changes; native standalone byte equality is the oracle.
- Metrics: retained raw measurement receipt, script and logs below; scoped development fixtures only.
- ADR/learning: n/a.

## Static Language Check

- [x] Static output avoids unsupported adequacy claims.
- [x] Unknowns/refusals retain native stop reasons.

## CI Economics

n/a: no workflows, branch protection, labels, hosted lanes or artifact upload policies changed.

## Engineering Check

- [x] No new production/test panic/unwrap/expect/todo/unimplemented calls.
- [x] No new non-Rust programming source, dependency or process/network producer.
- [x] Errors retain actionable context; public JSON/schema documented.

## Gates

- [x] `cargo xtask check-fast` (14 gates, including workspace/all-target Clippy with warnings denied)
- [x] `cargo xtask precommit` (all listed checks passed)
- [x] Focused native fan-out unit and CLI controls; Rust-only compile check.
- [ ] Hosted exact-head/integration qualification and parent independent review.

Full workspace tests, separate workspace check/doc/package/publish, release-profile performance, native Windows, hosted integration, cargo-deny and downstream UB qualification were not run or claimed.

## Review and continuation

Disposition: **REVIEW_INCOMPLETE**. Author inspection and a bounded read-only source challenge covered native rendering/configuration, source custody, destination binding, failure publication, non-UTF8 paths, byte bounds and separate presentation contexts. The challenge found two defects before the frozen head (unbound metadata reads and destination parent identity); both were repaired with controls. No remaining material source finding was reported at this head. This is not independent merge clearance; parent independent exact-head review follows.

```text
Owner / governing claim: sole writer for #8169; implementation delivered for parent review
Candidate: exact head 6a47f5bf094e5b010845b544f9464333a8b90d7d / tree 2a15b485aa9684ff9ea05159e429641433dd550b / basis b772d9e13cafcdc84a19ea77d9b90fbc6cb91ecc; GitHub PR head authoritative
Review: REVIEW_INCOMPLETE; bounded source challenge + author inspection; parent fresh independent review pending
Validation: exact-head local receipts below; hosted/native Windows/full workspace qualification unavailable
Dependency: #8180 owns inherited zip supply-chain repair; UB adoption retains existing qualification chain and #1358
Next: parent independently reviews exact published head; keep Draft; no Ready/merge/release/deployment authorization
```

Retained local evidence (not an uploaded CI artifact): `/workspace/scratch/8169-proof/evidence.json` and `/workspace/scratch/8169-measurements/receipt.json`; raw logs and source-challenge record under `/workspace/scratch/8169-*`. Frozen binary: `/workspace/scratch/8169-proof/ripr`, 219,336,312 bytes, one real copy (not a hardlink), SHA-256 `7d44305f188778ce3e85e0f950847e8f432d857b46502db897c68a73e42827f3`.
